full_page.content:
1933, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 160 Cont.
Nov. 24
Mary Judge - 55 - heart trouble etc.
Charles Senften - 73 - Ostomelitis bone infection over year - hands & feet turning black - no hope of recovery ... Anointed twice - Con- vert.
Sister Monica - 50 - Vertigo, Kidney trouble
Page 161 Nov. 24 Suzane McNally - 7 days old - heart trouble & complication. Enrol- led Oct. 19th 50c - To-night enrolled perpetually.
Nan Tobin - 7 - had T.B. in Kiefer Hospit. - had uncle 40 years from confession. Hoping the niece might be spared he went confession. Child is now O.K.
Baby Sam Pomilia - 1 month old - only child after 16 yrs waiting and prayers. Has serious bone trouble.
28 Leo Joly - 35 - of 6141 Cadillac Ave. - came last Nov. 22nd had "a dead hand". could hold a match if he prest fingers together with other hand. When he reached home he could pick up a chair, almost O.K. now.
Mary Strepp - 35 - fears necessity of being 4th time tapped. Mr. O'keefe - 90 -
Betty Jane Cutcher - 6 mo. - twin, mother died some time ago leav- ing 4 little ones.
Rose Cowen - 44 - nervous since 1909
Ernst Steiger - 42 - 4 little boys - inward goiter - 30 days to live if.
1933, December
Page 162 Dec. Mrs. Mary Kelly, N.Y. City, fighting breast cancer ten yrs. Now a lump forming on the other side.
Juliette Langevin - 22 - paralysis 4 yrs. Mother came from Texas .. .
Mr. Geo Clear ...... about 50 - .. . . palsey or ...
